row.evidence: Close's help centre says "At the moment we don't support other SSO providers such as Auth0 or Okta"; only Google sign-in is offered, and no SCIM endpoint appears in the pricing page, help centre or API reference.
row.notes: New row. Plans (annual, per user/month): Solo $9 (1 user only), Essentials $35, Growth $99, Scale $139; monthly billing is $19/$49/$109/$149. No SAML/OIDC SSO with a customer IdP (Google sign-in only) and no SCIM. Every plan includes the REST API (API key or OAuth), whose Memberships endpoints can provision a user by email (the org must restrict sign-ups to verified domains), change role and deactivate the membership; no IdP connector uses it. Removing a user keeps their activity, disables their API keys and holds the paid seat open until the next billing cycle. The event log API (30 days) and webhooks include membership activated/deactivated events.

plans.notes: Limited to 1 user, so not the team plan.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Custom roles and Groups are Scale-only.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint, SCIM help article or SCIM API page exists in help.close.com/llms.txt or developer.close.com/llms.txt; Close only supports Google sign-in. False by absence.

capabilities.notes: POST /membership/ adds an existing user or provisions a new one by email (also re-adds a removed user); DELETE /membership/{id}/ deactivates the membership rather than deleting the user. User profile fields are read-only; updates are membership settings and role.

endpoints.purpose: Create a membership (add or provision a user by email with a role)
Deactivate a membership, removing the user from the organization
Add a user to a group
Remove a user from a group

audit_log_api.notes: Event log API (object change log, 30 days), listed as 'API access + event log' on every plan.

rate_limits.text: Per endpoint group, enforced per API key and per organization (organization limit is 3x the per-key limit); 429 with RateLimit and retry-after headers.

limitations.text: Creating a membership requires the 'Restrict new users to emails from these domains' setting and an email on a verified domain; the new role cannot grant manage_organization.
Groups and custom roles are only available on Scale (and legacy Enterprise).
List endpoints paginate with _skip/_limit or cursors.

okta.notes: Close says it does not support Okta as an SSO provider; okta.com/integrations/close/, /close-io/ and /closeio/ return 404.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial found (close-tutorial, closeio-tutorial 404).

google.notes: 'Sign in with Google' (social login) only; not a SAML app and does not provision.

fallbacks.notes: Users are invited one at a time from Settings > Team Management; Google sign-in can create an account at sign-up, but that is not IdP-driven JIT into an existing organization.
